notes.title: [UPDATE] Version 1.4 is here !
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40100324/57c261d5ecf52faff6974c67aafa5de70c590ff5.png

Version 1.4 is here !

and here's what she brings with her!

New arrivals :

• Multiplayer !
Face up to 8 Players and respond as fast and as best as possible in order to win the game!

• Player Profile !
Look other player's statistics or, your's


Patchs :

• Cannot click the same button twice in a row at an interval of less than 2 seconds

• Saving sound settings between each game start


Changes :

• Deletion of VorTeXDev accounts ! (We now use Steam Accounts)

• Deletion of confirmation when deleting a quiz


Note : Quizzes and VorTeX accounts have been deleted.



Thanks for reading !

Take the time to put a Positive vote ːsteamthumbsupː !
